layout: pixels and expected are row-major HWC uint8; expected is the resized image before the 1/255 rescale
note: Pillow resamples one axis, stores an 8-bit intermediate, then resamples the other, so the pass order moves a few samples by one level. Pillow 13 picks the order from the shrink ratios (ImagingResampleInner in Resample.c); Pillow 12 and earlier always went horizontal first. horizontal_first records which branch each case takes. families/tipsv2/requirements.txt pins the version these values came from, and tests/test_model.py recomputes them with the installed Pillow.

width shrinks while height grows: horizontal pass first
